scope: Chapter compilation of independent closed-loop simulations using their recorded configurations. No omitted simulation frames or time scaling. Reused training appearance; not real-vehicle validation.

source_configuration.scope: Monocular image-based 2.5D integration simulation; reused training appearance. Not independent recognition evaluation or real-vehicle safety validation.
source_configuration.truth_access: Renderer and scorer only. Controller uses model masks/probabilities, their history, and simulated measured speed.
source_configuration.timing: Fixed simulated time; inference latency is measured but not injected into feedback. Not a real-time or delay-robustness claim.

reference_profile.name: BlueROV2 planar inspection reference with 4K Cam
reference_profile.scope: Published hardware references plus explicit uncalibrated planar simulation assumptions

published_vehicle.usage: Dimensional and propulsion reference, not a deep-sea pressure-rating claim

camera.model: Blue Robotics 4K Cam (wide setting, nominal pinhole)
camera.published_delay_test_setup: 1080p30 on 2024 M3 MacBook Air; not direct inference-input delay

simulation.delay_usage: Stress proxy only; do not equate display latency with measured camera-to-inference delay

assumption_notes: No calibrated lens distortion, housing refraction, current compensation or tether drag
Planar surge/yaw only; published lateral/heave abilities are not fully implemented
Stopping surge is not verified station keeping
Hydrostatic depth, pressure and lighting physics are not simulated

source_configuration.encounter_geometry: Original horizontal footprint stop rule plus evaluation-only fixed-height sphere clearance; no depth control

synthetic_inspection_criteria.usage: scoring only, never fed to controller

appearance_manifest.photographic_material: full photograph with row-wise pipe rectification, reflected tiling; source labels are renderer material only
appearance_manifest.fish_annotation: manually outlined appearance sprite, not real-video evaluation ground truth

source_configuration.scope: Actual XYZ fish/pipe closed loop; reused training material, not independent generalization.
source_configuration.controller_truth_access: RGB, predicted masks, measured pose, explicit geometric priors only; fish XYZ and contact envelopes exclusively renderer/scorer.
source_configuration.timing: Fixed 30 Hz simulation; measured inference wall time not injected.
source_configuration.contact_scoring: 3D assumed sphere envelopes and legacy XY projection are scored separately; a 3D pass never overwrites a legacy 2D failure.

config.camera_mount: Forward pan/tilt camera, initially 45 degrees downward; pose follows RGB-estimated pipe
config.assumptions: XYZ cylinder/capsule scene. Known incoming pipe floor datum, diameter and local X/depth plane; ideal camera extrinsics and measured odometry. Hull stays level. Pan/tilt and heave responses are simulation assumptions, not published BlueROV2 actuator performance.
